children: sank 8%, falling for the third straight day as investors await news on its planned $500 sale to Western Union.
Citi is moving back its close date for the Intermex
deal to Nov. 10 as a California regulator is still reviewing the deal and the timing will be beyond the original September assumption, analyst Bryan Keane wrote in a note on Thursday.

"We believe WU is still pushing hard to get this deal done before 11/10," Keane wrote. "Importantly, the deal economics remain supported by greater synergy potential than originally contemplated, which could help offset IMXI's standalone revenue and operating profit tracking below initial expectations."
Citi's Keane, who has a neutral rating on Western Union
, lowered his price target to $6 from $7 to reflect increased "deal uncertainty."
